description: Central-bank style OCR call and annual CPI forecast (fiscal-looking 'year to June' used for CPI).

v1.text: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE. Monetary Policy Statement (synthetic). We expect the OCR to be cut to 2.25% by February 2027 and to stay there through 2027.
Annual CPI inflation is projected to return to 2.0% in the year to June 2027. The risks to the inflation outlook are balanced.
